title: autopg manifest v1
description: Light-touch v1 manifest declaring per-app provisioning needs. Per Group 5 (autopg-distribution-cutover wish): no `publisher_sig` field — signatures live in detached `autopg.json.sig` per cosign convention.

app.description: Per-app slug. Maps 1:1 to the SCRAM role + owned DB created by `autopg create-app`.

database.description: Database name to create (or adopt via --adopt-existing-db).

extensions.description: Extensions to CREATE EXTENSION inside the owned DB. Restricted to a known-safe allow-list at provisioning time.

privileges.description: Privilege predicates the per-app role gets on the owned DB. v1 accepts the symbolic strings 'crud' and 'ddl'; ownership of the DB is implicit.

max_connections.description: Per-role connection cap (ALTER ROLE … CONNECTION LIMIT).
